    Common corners for two-ended string hooks #

    This file constructs the signed path obtained by applying a maximal hook at both endpoints of a nontrivial string. The signs at the two seams block relations from crossing the whole word, while the nonempty original word prevents a new inverse pair from spanning both seams.
